criterion_a.title: Climate Crisis
criterion_a.scenario: News Reporter describing an environmental report.
criterion_a.master_script: The rapid melting of Arctic ice is a clear indicator of global warming. We must take immediate action to reduce carbon emissions. Reducing waste and saving energy are simple ways to help our planet stay healthy and green for everyone. If we all work together, we can make a big difference in protecting our environment. Every small change in our daily lives, like recycling plastic or using less water, adds up to a cleaner future for the next generation. Let's start making better choices today to ensure a sustainable world for tomorrow. It is not too late to act, but we must be consistent and dedicated to this global cause. Our earth is beautiful, and keeping it that way is our shared responsibility.

vocabulary.definition: A thing that indicates the state or level of something.
The production and discharge of something, especially gas or radiation.
Able to be maintained at a certain rate or level.
The state or fact of having a duty to deal with something.

criterion_a.title: Artificial Intelligence
criterion_a.master_script: Artificial intelligence is revolutionizing health care and education. It helps doctors find diseases faster and helps students learn at their own pace. While some people worry about robots, most experts agree that AI will move us forward in very positive ways. By using smart machines, we can solve complex problems that were once impossible. For example, AI can analyze huge amounts of weather data to predict storms more accurately, saving many lives. In schools, AI tutors can help children who are struggling with math or language. This technology is a powerful tool that makes our lives easier and more efficient. As we continue to develop AI, we must focus on using it safely and fairly for the benefit of all people around the world.

criterion_a.title: Sustainable Fashion
criterion_a.master_script: Many brands are now adopting recycled materials to create beautiful clothes. This shift toward sustainable fashion is helping to reduce the huge amount of waste produced by the clothing industry. You can help by choosing quality over quantity and supporting companies that care about the earth. Fast fashion often leads to pollution and poor working conditions, so being a mindful shopper is very important. When you buy a piece of clothing, think about how long it will last and where it came from. Buying second-hand or swapping clothes with friends are also great ways to be stylish and eco-friendly. Small steps like these can change the way the world thinks about fashion. Let's celebrate style that doesn't harm our planet.

criterion_a.title: Local Traditions
criterion_a.master_script: The annual Fire Dragon Dance attracts thousands of visitors to our city every year. This vibrant tradition involves hundreds of performers carrying a dragon made of glowing incense sticks through the narrow streets. It is a symbol of luck and protection for the local community. The rhythmic drumming and the smell of the burning incense create a magical atmosphere that you will never forget. Families gather to watch the parade, and children often carry their own small lanterns. This festival has been celebrated for over a century, passing down stories and values from one generation to the next. It reminds us of our history and the strength of our community. We invite you to join us in this colorful celebration of our unique heritage and culture.

criterion_a.title: E-Learning Apps
criterion_a.master_script: Our new e-learning app is designed to make studying fun and effective for students of all ages. With interactive lessons and colorful games, you can master difficult subjects like science and history in no time. The app tracks your progress and gives you rewards for every challenge you complete. You can study anywhere, whether you are on a bus or relaxing at home. The lessons are short and easy to follow, making it perfect for a quick review before a big exam. We also include videos with clear explanations from expert teachers. If you ever get stuck, our smart assistant is there to help you step by step. Download the app today and discover how exciting learning can be when you have the right tools in your pocket.

criterion_a.title: Mental Health
criterion_a.master_script: It is absolutely essential to prioritize mental well-being in our modern, fast-paced society. As burnout becomes increasingly common among students and working professionals alike, we must encourage open and honest conversations about stress. By supporting each other and seeking professional guidance when needed, we can foster a more compassionate and resilient community. Mental health is just as important as physical health, and no one should feel ashamed of their struggles. Taking time to rest, practicing mindfulness, and staying connected with friends are simple but effective ways to maintain balance. We need to break the stigma and create environments where everyone feels safe to speak up. Remember, you are never alone in this journey, and help is always available if you reach out. Let's make mental health a priority for everyone.

criterion_a.title: Digital Literacy
criterion_a.master_script: Understanding how to verify online information is a crucial skill in the age of the internet. With so much data available at our fingertips, it can be quite challenging to distinguish between factual reports and misleading rumors. We must learn to check multiple sources and question the motives behind the content we consume. Being digitally literate means more than just knowing how to use a computer; it is about thinking critically and behaving responsibly in digital spaces. Protect your private information and be mindful of your digital footprint, as what you post today can follow you for years. By becoming smart and informed digital citizens, we can prevent the spread of misinformation and make the internet a safer place for everyone. Let's commit to learning these essential skills together for a brighter, more informed future.

criterion_a.title: Space Exploration
criterion_a.master_script: The future of space exploration depends on our ability to develop sustainable technologies for long-term missions. Scientists are currently working on ways to grow food on Mars and recycle air and water more efficiently than ever before. These developments not only help us reach other planets but also provide valuable insights into protecting our own environment here on Earth. Exploring the cosmos pushes the boundaries of human knowledge and inspires the next generation of engineers and explorers. Every mission brings us closer to answering the fundamental question of whether we are alone in the universe. While the challenges are immense, the potential rewards for humanity are even greater. As we look toward the stars, we are reminded of our shared curiosity and our determination to understand the vast mysteries of space. The journey has only just begun.

criterion_a.title: E-Sports Industry
criterion_a.master_script: Competitive gaming has evolved into a multi-billion dollar industry that attracts millions of viewers worldwide. Major tournaments now fill massive stadiums, with professional players earning significant salaries and lucrative sponsorship deals. This rapid growth has led many to reconsider the definition of traditional sports and the skills required to compete at the highest level. E-sports demand intense focus, lightning-fast reflexes, and complex strategic thinking. Schools and universities are now offering scholarships for talented gamers, recognizing the dedication required to excel in this digital arena. However, the industry also faces challenges such as ensuring player health and managing the pressure of constant competition. As technology continues to advance, the boundary between physical and virtual competition will likely continue to blur. The rise of e-sports is a testament to the changing landscape of global entertainment and technology.

criterion_a.title: Home Gardening
criterion_a.master_script: Starting a small garden at home is a rewarding way to connect with nature and enjoy fresh, organic produce right from your balcony. Even if you have very limited space, you can easily grow herbs like mint, basil, and rosemary in simple pots or vertical planters. The process of watching a tiny seed grow into a healthy plant is incredibly satisfying and can provide a much-needed escape from the stress of urban life. Gardening also helps you appreciate the effort required to produce the food we eat every day. Besides being a productive hobby, it adds a touch of greenery to your living space, improving the air quality and creating a peaceful atmosphere. In today's video, I will show you some easy tips for beginners, from choosing the right soil to managing sunlight and water. Let's transform our small spaces into beautiful, green sanctuaries together.

criterion_a.title: Urban Farming
criterion_a.master_script: Rooftop gardens in densely populated cities not only provide fresh produce but also play a pivotal role in mitigating the urban heat island effect. These green spaces, which are often maintained by dedicated community volunteers, transform neglected concrete surfaces into vibrant, productive ecosystems. This sustainable approach to urbanization effectively addresses food security concerns while simultaneously enhancing the environmental quality of our metropolitan areas. By reducing the energy required for cooling buildings and capturing rainwater, urban farms contribute to a city's overall resilience against climate change. Furthermore, they serve as vital social hubs where residents of all ages can gather to learn about biology and nutrition. Implementing such initiatives on a larger scale requires strong collaboration between government planners, private developers, and local neighborhoods. As we look toward the future, integrating agriculture into our urban architecture will be essential for creating healthier and more self-sufficient communities.

criterion_a.title: Ancient History
criterion_a.master_script: The discovery of the hidden tomb revealed fascinating details about the sophisticated burial rituals of this ancient civilization. Archaeologists found remarkably well-preserved artifacts, including intricate jewelry and ornate pottery, which provide profound insights into the social hierarchy and artistic values of the era. These findings challenge our previous understanding of the region's historical development and suggest a level of cultural exchange that was far more extensive than once believed. By carefully analyzing the inscriptions on the walls, researchers are pieceing together the stories of the individuals who lived thousands of years ago. It is through these painstaking efforts that we can begin to appreciate the complexity of their beliefs regarding life, death, and the afterlife. This discovery serves as a powerful reminder of the enduring legacy left behind by those who came before us and the importance of preserving our shared human heritage for future study.

criterion_a.title: Renewable Energy
criterion_a.master_script: Solar and wind power are no longer merely alternative options; they have become the fundamental pillars of our transition toward a carbon-neutral economy. The rapid advancements in battery storage technology have successfully addressed the intermittent nature of solar and wind generation, ensuring a stable and reliable supply of energy for both industrial and domestic needs. As the cost of manufacturing these technologies continues to decrease, they are becoming increasingly competitive with traditional fossil fuels on a global scale. However, achieving a complete transition requires significant investment in our aging power grids and the implementation of innovative smart-grid solutions. Engineers are also exploring the potential of green hydrogen as a versatile energy carrier for heavy industry and long-distance transportation. Moving forward, the integration of diverse renewable sources will be the key to ensuring energy security while simultaneously meeting our ambitious climate goals. The revolution in energy production is well under way.

criterion_a.title: The Gig Economy
criterion_a.master_script: While providing unprecedented flexibility for many workers, the rapid expansion of the gig economy raises significant concerns regarding labor rights and longstading social protections. Many individuals who rely on digital platforms for their income lack access to traditional benefits such as health insurance, paid leave, and retirement contributions. This shift toward a more precarious form of employment has prompted intense debates about the legal classification of gig workers and the responsibilities of platform companies. Proponents argue that the gig economy empowers individuals to manage their own schedules and pursue diverse opportunities, while critics highlight the lack of job security and the potential for exploitation. Finding a balance that protects workers' well-being without stifling innovation is one of the most pressing challenges for policymakers in the twenty-first century. As the nature of work continues to evolve, we must ensure that our legal frameworks are capable of providing a fair and equitable environment for all types of employees.

criterion_a.title: Remote Working
criterion_a.master_script: The sudden transition to widespread remote working has fundamentally altered our traditional concepts of the workplace and professional collaboration. While many employees report increased productivity and a better work-life balance, the lack of physical interaction has also led to concerns about mental health and the erosion of corporate culture. Organizations are now forced to adopt digital communication tools and implement new management strategies that focus on outcomes rather than physical presence. Ensuring that employees remain engaged and connected while working from disparate locations requires a proactive approach to team building and transparent communication. Furthermore, the shift has exposed significant disparities in digital access and the suitability of home environments for professional tasks. Companies must carefully consider these factors when designing long-term hybrid models that combine the benefits of remote work with the advantages of face-to-face interaction. The future of the office is currently being redefined through this unprecedented global experiment.

criterion_a.title: Ocean Conservation
criterion_a.master_script: Overfishing and plastic pollution are devastating our marine ecosystems, leading to a catastrophic decline in biodiversity that threatens the very foundation of our global food security. The indiscriminate destruction of coral reefs, often referred to as the 'rainforests of the sea,' has profound implications for countless species that depend on these habitats for survival. It is imperative that we implement stringent international regulations and establish robust marine protected areas where commercial activities are strictly prohibited. Furthermore, we must address the root causes of plastic waste by transitioning toward a circular economy and advocating for sustainable alternatives to single-use plastics. The health of our oceans is inextricably linked to the stability of our global climate, making ocean conservation a critical component of any comprehensive environmental strategy. We cannot afford to remain indifferent to the silent crisis unfolding beneath the waves. The time for proactive, unified action is now, before the damage to these vital ecosystems becomes truly irreversible. Our survival depends on the resilience of the blue planet.

criterion_a.title: Virtual Reality
criterion_a.master_script: Virtual reality technology is fundamentally transforming the educational landscape by providing students with immersive, experiential learning opportunities that were previously inconceivable within a traditional classroom setting. By simulating complex historical events, intricate biological processes, or even distant planetary environments, VR enables a level of engagement and comprehension that surpasses conventional pedagogical methods. This technology allows learners to interact with digital representations of abstract concepts, fostering a deeper, more intuitive understanding of the subject matter. However, the widespread adoption of VR in education faces significant hurdles, including the substantial cost of hardware and the specialized training required for educators to integrate these tools effectively into their curricula. Moreover, concerns regarding the potential psychological impacts and the necessity of high-quality content development must be addressed to ensure that VR remains a beneficial educational tool. Despite these challenges, the potential for VR to democratize access to high-quality education and inspire a new generation of learners is truly unparalleled. The future of learning is undoubtedly immersive.

criterion_a.title: Public Transport
criterion_a.master_script: An efficient and interconnected public transportation network is the absolute cornerstone of any sustainable urban planning strategy, serving as a vital instrument for reducing carbon emissions and alleviating chronic traffic congestion in our rapidly expanding metropolitan areas. By prioritizing investment in high-capacity rail systems and comprehensive bus networks, cities can provide residents with reliable, affordable alternatives to private vehicle ownership. Furthermore, the integration of 'last-mile' solutions, such as bike-sharing programs and pedestrian-friendly infrastructure, is essential for creating a seamless and truly accessible transit experience. However, the successful implementation of such ambitious projects requires long-term political commitment and substantial financial resources. Planners must also consider the potential for transit-oriented development to revitalize neglected neighborhoods and promote social equity by improving access to employment and essential services. As we strive to create more livable and resilient cities, the modernization of our public transport infrastructure must remain a top priority. A world-class transit system is not merely a convenience; it is a fundamental requirement for the functional integrity of our future urban environments.

criterion_a.title: Cybersecurity Threats
criterion_a.master_script: As our global infrastructure becomes inextricably linked to digital networks, the exposure to sophisticated cybersecurity threats has escalated exponentially, posing a direct challenge to the integrity of our modern civilization. Sophisticated actors, ranging from lone hackers to state-sponsored organizations, often exploit minor vulnerabilities to orchestrate large-scale data breaches, which can have catastrophic implications for both individual privacy and national security. Therefore, the implementation of robust, multi-layered encryption protocols and the adoption of zero-trust architectures are no longer luxuries but fundamental necessities for any organization. We must cultivate a culture of relentless vigilance and proactive defense, acknowledging that the cyber landscape is constantly evolving and that purely reactive measures are insufficient. Furthermore, the ethical implications of AI-driven cyber attacks and the potential for autonomous digital warfare require urgent international dialogue and the establishment of clear legal frameworks. To safeguard our interconnected future, we must prioritize the development of resilient systems that can withstand and recover from coordinated digital assaults. Our collective security in the twenty-first century depends on our mastery of the digital realm.

criterion_a.title: Quantum Computing
criterion_a.master_script: Quantum computing represents a paradigm shift in our computational capabilities, promising to solve problems that are currently beyond the theoretical reach of even the most powerful classical supercomputers. By harnessing the principles of quantum mechanics, such as superposition and entanglement, researchers are developing processors that can perform complex calculations at speeds that would revolutionize fields ranging from drug discovery to materials science. The potential to simulate molecular interactions with unprecedented precision could lead to the development of life-saving medications and high-efficiency energy storage solutions. However, the realization of fully functional, large-scale quantum computers remains a formidable engineering challenge, requiring the maintenance of extremely low temperatures and the mitigation of quantum decoherence. Scientists are also grappling with the implications for global cybersecurity, as quantum algorithms have the potential to render many of our current encryption methods obsolete. Despite these immense hurdles, the global race to master quantum technology is accelerating, driven by the profound realization that the quantum era will fundamentally redefine our relationship with information and the physical world. We are standing on the brink of a new scientific frontier.

criterion_d.title: School Policy: Mobile Phones
criterion_d.scenario: A student debate on whether mobile phones should be allowed during lunch breaks.
criterion_d.starting_question: Do you believe allowing mobile phones during lunch breaks would be beneficial or distracting for students?
criterion_d.guidance: Use P.E.E.L: State your Point (e.g., social connection), provide Evidence (e.g., keeping in touch with parents), Explain why it matters, and Link back to wait reason.

criterion_d.title: Chatbots in Classrooms
criterion_d.scenario: A school board meeting discussing the official integration of AI chatbots for student homework assistance.
criterion_d.starting_question: Do you think schools should encourage the use of AI chatbots for homework, or does it pose too great a risk to academic integrity?
criterion_d.guidance: Use P.E.E.L to explain how personalized tutoring could benefit slower learners, then link it to the risk of students skipping the 'thinking' process.

criterion_d.title: Northward Consumption Trend
criterion_d.scenario: A business talk show discussing why more Hong Kongers are choosing to spend their weekends in Shenzhen.
criterion_d.starting_question: In your opinion, what are the main reasons for the 'Northward Consumption' trend, and how should local Hong Kong businesses respond?
criterion_d.guidance: Try to categorize your points into 'Economic factors' and 'Customer experience'. Link the service quality in Shenzhen to the need for HK staff training.

criterion_d.title: Plastic-Free Dining
criterion_d.scenario: A group of students sharing their experiences with paper and wood straws after the plastic ban.
criterion_d.starting_question: Has the ban on single-use plastic tableware made a positive difference in your habits, or is it mostly just an inconvenience?
criterion_d.guidance: Focus on the practical aspect. Mention the durability of paper straws as 'Evidence' for your point about user experience.

criterion_d.title: Youth Mental Health
criterion_d.scenario: A youth forum discussing the rising stress levels among secondary school students.
criterion_d.starting_question: What systemic changes in the education system would most effectively alleviate the mental health crisis among students?
criterion_d.guidance: Elaborate on 'Exam-oriented culture'. Explain how it leads to a 'burnout' cycle, and link it back to the need for a holistic curriculum.

criterion_d.title: Revitalizing Temple Street
criterion_d.scenario: A tourism committee reviewing the 'Night Vibes Hong Kong' campaign.
criterion_d.starting_question: Is the introduction of street food and night markets enough to revitalize traditional spots like Temple Street for the long term?
criterion_d.guidance: Connect the 'Authentic atmosphere' to the emotional value of heritage. Link it to the challenge of balancing tourism with local residents' peace.

criterion_d.title: E-sports as a Profession
criterion_d.scenario: A career planning session where a student expresses interest in becoming a pro gamer.
criterion_d.starting_question: Should professional gaming be treated with the same respect and funding as traditional physical sports?
criterion_d.guidance: Use evidence like 'reflex speed' and 'strategy' to support the 'High skill' point. Link the 'short career span' to the need for education fallback.

criterion_d.title: The 'Slashie' Lifestyle
criterion_d.scenario: A seminar on the future of work and the rise of multi-hyphenate (Slashie) workers.
criterion_d.starting_question: Is the 'Slashie' lifestyle a sign of true professional freedom, or is it a symptom of an unstable job market?
criterion_d.guidance: Analyze the term 'freedom'. Contrast it with 'financial uncertainty'. Link the passion factor to the long-term career satisfaction.

criterion_d.title: Heritage vs. Urban Renewal
criterion_d.scenario: A community meeting regarding the demolition of a 1950s tenement building in Sham Shui Po.
criterion_d.starting_question: How should we resolve the conflict between the need for modern housing and the preservation of Hong Kong's cultural landmarks?
criterion_d.guidance: Explain the concept of 'Cultural identity'. Link it to the 'Tourism value' as a reason for adaptive reuse instead of demolition.

criterion_d.title: Future of Physical Libraries
criterion_d.scenario: A public consultation on whether to convert under-utilized public libraries into community study centers.
criterion_d.starting_question: With the rise of e-books and internet research, are physical libraries still a necessary part of our community?
criterion_d.guidance: Focus on 'Digital equity'. Explain why libraries are still essential for students who don't have a quiet or high-tech home environment.

criterion_d.title: Pet-Friendly Public Transport
criterion_d.scenario: A debate in a transportation forum on allowing small pets in carriers on all public transport during non-peak hours.
criterion_d.starting_question: Should Hong Kong's public transport system be more inclusive of pets, or would it cause too much disruption for other passengers?
criterion_d.guidance: Categorize your points by 'Passenger Comfort' vs 'Pet Owner Rights'. Link the 'Reduced private car use' to environmental goals.

criterion_d.title: The 'Right to Disconnect'
criterion_d.scenario: A labor rights seminar discussing the implementation of legislation to prevent after-hours work communication.
criterion_d.starting_question: Should employees have a legal 'Right to Disconnect' after work hours, or is constant availability necessary in today's global economy?
criterion_d.guidance: Synthesize the need for 'Mental health recovery' with the reality of 'Global client demands'. Propose a compromise like 'emergency-only' protocols.

criterion_d.title: Vertical Farming in HK
criterion_d.scenario: A town hall meeting discussing the use of abandoned industrial buildings for high-tech vertical agriculture.
criterion_d.starting_question: Can vertical farming truly solve Hong Kong's food security issues, or is it an expensive and impractical high-tech fantasy?
criterion_d.guidance: Use 'Land use efficiency' as a major point for HK. Link 'High energy consumption' to the need for renewable energy integration.

criterion_d.title: E-sports in the Olympics
criterion_d.scenario: A sports committee meeting debating the inclusion of competitive gaming in future Olympic Games.
criterion_d.starting_question: Does including E-sports in the Olympics uphold the traditional spirit of sportsmanship, or does it diminish the prestige of physical athletics?
criterion_d.guidance: Define the 'Olympic Spirit'. Link 'Engaging youth' as a survival strategy for the Games in the digital age.

criterion_d.title: The Cashless Society
criterion_d.scenario: A financial forum discussing the gradual phasing out of physical cash in favor of digital wallets and cards.
criterion_d.starting_question: Is a completely cashless society an inevitable and beneficial evolution for Hong Kong, or does it threaten the privacy and inclusion of the elderly?
criterion_d.guidance: Analyze the 'Elderly exclusion' point deeply. Link it to the 'Digital divide' and propose transitional measures like 'dual systems'.

criterion_d.title: Autonomous Transport
criterion_d.scenario: Transportation planning review on self-driving taxis.
criterion_d.starting_question: Evaluate the ethical and logistical implications of replacing human taxi drivers with autonomous systems in a high-density urban environment.
criterion_d.guidance: Focus on the 'Synthesis' part of DSE Criterion D. Link logical points between job security and social stability.

criterion_d.title: AI in Creative Arts
criterion_d.scenario: An arts council debate on whether to allow AI-generated works in prestigious national competitions.
criterion_d.starting_question: To what extent does the use of AI in creative fields redefine our understanding of 'authorship' and the unique value of human inspiration?
criterion_d.guidance: Challenge the assumption that 'Creativity' is uniquely human. Synthesize the 'Democratization' benefit with the 'Devaluation' of professional skills.

criterion_d.title: Digital Detox Mandates
criterion_d.scenario: A policy review on mandating 'No-Screen' days in secondary schools and corporations to combat social media fatigue.
criterion_d.starting_question: Are mandated digital detoxes an essential intervention for public mental health, or an overreach into personal freedom and modern productivity?
criterion_d.guidance: Focus on the 'Erosion of autonomy' right. Link 'Attention span' to long-term cognitive health as a justification for systemic intervention.

criterion_d.title: Universal Basic Income (UBI)
criterion_d.scenario: An economic summit discussing UBI as a response to the potential loss of 40% of jobs to AI and automation.
criterion_d.starting_question: Evaluate Universal Basic Income as a viable solution to the existential threat posed by automation to traditional labor markets.
criterion_d.guidance: Synthesize the 'Robot Tax' concept with 'Social security floor'. Link the 'Dignity' point to the psychological value of work.

criterion_d.title: Philosophy of 'Slow Living'
criterion_d.scenario: A cultural symposium exploring the feasibility of 'Slow Living' in the context of Hong Kong's hyper-capitalist urban environment.
criterion_d.starting_question: Is the 'Slow Living' movement a realistic alternative for Hong Kongers, or is it an unattainable luxury reserved for the affluent?
criterion_d.guidance: Analyze the 'Hustle culture' of HK. Link it to the 'Mental wellness' crisis as a driver for change, but synthesize it with the 'High cost of living' barrier.
